written_before: any delta on a fresh slab was read; nothing below was computed after this file was written
form: delta(nW, nP) = | sum over paths, over each path's columns, x_k * column_k |, columns as code/measure/wall-leak-channels.ts pathColumns: q 0 -> e^(-kappa n), q pi -> e^(-kappa n) (-1)^n, other q -> e^(-kappa n) cos(q n), e^(-kappa n) sin(q n); n = nW on side 0 (Wilson), nP on side 1 (plain)
roots_rule: from the bulk symbol alone (bulkBlocks + piRoots at K = 0, quasienergy pi, sigma 0.6 e^(0.3 i)), E-SPN-0198; the run re-derives them and must match to 1e-9
coefficient_rule: the 5 coefficients fitted in E-SPN-0198 (item 0050, tmp/leak-refit.log 'wilson second root') by fitPaths on the 45 old slabs nW + nP <= 16, copied verbatim and NEVER refit. They are not bulk-derived: a wall state's overlap with each root is a property of the wall, not the bulk. Order: wilson leading q pi; wilson pair cos, sin; plain q 0, q pi

gates.pass: every fresh slab has factor <= 1.5 (no live exclusion: every slab counts)
gates.open: an instrument fails: a re-derived root off its frozen kappa or q by more than 1e-9, or old slabs (8,9) and (11,6) off tmp/leak.log by more than 1e-12 relative

fresh_rule: every slab has nW or nP outside 4..12, so none is in the 81-slab grid; L = nW + nP from 20 to 28
